title: COMPACT: Spectral Adjustment Scores from an Exhaustive and Nonredundant Set of Invariant Relations
abstract: arXiv:2608.10305v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Observational datasets frequently contain many baseline variables, yet investigators estimating causal effects may not know which variables to include in the adjustment set. Confounding information may also be distributed weakly across many variables. Propensity scores can simplify adjustment by reducing high-dimensional covariates to a scalar with binary treatment. Although the propensity score is the coarsest balancing score, this balancing property does not necessarily distinguish among causal structures relevant to adjustment. We instead examine all causal graphs among a candidate score, treatment, and outcome while allowing latent variables. Under faithfulness, we identify all unconditional and conditional dependence relations that remain unchanged when the treatment-to-outcome edge is added or removed, leaving treatment-effect estimation to the downstream analysis. Together, these relations define the smallest compatible

translated_title: COMPACT：基于穷举且非冗余不变关系集合的谱调整得分
translated_abstract: 观测数据集通常包含大量基线变量，然而在估计因果效应时，研究者可能并不知道哪些变量应纳入调整集合。混杂信息也可能微弱地分布在多个变量之中。倾向得分可以通过在二值处理下将高维协变量缩减为一个标量来简化调整过程。尽管倾向得分是最粗的平衡得分，但这一平衡性质并不一定能够区分与调整相关的因果结构。我们转而检验候选得分、处理和结局之间的所有因果图，同时允许存在潜在变量。在忠实性假设下，我们识别出所有在添加或移除处理到结局的边时保持不变的无条件与条件依赖关系，并将处理效应估计留给下游分析。这些关系共同定义了最小兼容的……
tldr: 该论文提出COMPACT方法，通过穷举检验候选得分、处理与结局之间（允许潜在变量）的所有因果图，识别出在处理到结局的边被添加或移除时保持不变的无条件与条件依赖关系的穷举且非冗余集合，从而构建谱调整得分以辅助因果调整变量选择。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes COMPACT, a spectral adjustment score built from an exhaustive and nonredundant set of unconditional and conditional dependence relations that remain invariant under the addition or removal of the treatment-to-outcome edge across all causal graphs among a candidate score, treatment, and outcome, while allowing latent variables.
